dish.title: Penne alla Vodka with Basil
dish.description: Penne tossed in a rosy sauce of shallot, garlic, and red pepper flakes cooked in butter and olive oil with tomato paste and crushed tomatoes, simmered with vodka, finished with heavy cream and a vegetarian Parmesan-style cheese, and topped with basil.

recipe_version.title: Penne alla Vodka with Basil
recipe_version.description: Penne tossed in a rosy sauce of shallot, garlic, and red pepper flakes cooked in butter and olive oil with tomato paste and crushed tomatoes, simmered with vodka, finished with heavy cream and a vegetarian Parmesan-style cheese, and topped with basil.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp pasta pot, the rest sauce

ingredients.name: Parmesan-style cheese
ingredients.display_name: vegetarian Parmesan-style cheese made with microbial rennet

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Mince the shallot and garlic and grate the cheese.

steps.title: Heat the pot
steps.body: Bring 16 cups water and 2 tbsp salt to a boil in the covered 8-quart pot over high, about 16 minutes to come to a boil.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: While the pot heats (overlap stated): warm the oil and butter in the 12-inch skillet over medium until the butter foams, about 1 minute. Cook the shallot until soft, about 3 minutes, then the garlic and pepper flakes for 1 minute. Stir in the tomato paste and cook until brick red, about 3 minutes. Off the heat add the vodka, then simmer until nearly gone, about 2 minutes. Add the crushed tomatoes and a pinch of salt and simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the penne
steps.body: Cook the penne in the pot, stirring now and then, until al dente, about 11 minutes. Meanwhile stir the cream into the sauce and keep it at a bare simmer. Scoop out 1 cup of the pasta cooking liquid, then drain.

steps.title: Toss
steps.body: Add the penne to the sauce with 3/4 of the cheese and a splash of the cooking liquid and toss over low heat until the sauce turns glossy and clings, about 2 minutes, adding more liquid as needed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve topped with the remaining cheese and torn basil.
